title: Potato and Dumplings Russian Delight
description: A hearty and comforting Russian-inspired dish featuring pan-seared potato dumplings, crispy fried onions, and aromatic spices.
instructions: Boil the dumplings according to package instructions. Set aside.
Heat a large skillet over medium heat. Add a small amount of oil.
Add the diced potato to the skillet and cook until golden brown.
Add the boiled dumplings to the skillet with the potato.
Sprinkle the chopped dill on top of the dumplings and potato.
Serve the potato and dumplings hot, topped with crispy fried onions.
Garnish with additional chopped dill if desired.
